sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id), CAST(COUNT(T2.person_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.season = 9 AND T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T2.category = 'Cast'

SELECT T2.keyword FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id=T2.episode_id WHERE T1.votes = (SELECT MAX(E.votes) FROM Episode E JOIN Keyword K ON E.episode_id=K.episode_id WHERE E.votes < (SELECT MAX(E2.votes) FROM Episode E2 JOIN Keyword K2 ON E2.episode_id=K2.episode_id))
SELECT DISTINCT T1.birth_region FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.role = 'assistant location manager'

SELECT DISTINCT A.year, A.episode_id FROM Award A JOIN Person P ON A.person_id=P.person_id WHERE P.name='Constantine Makris' AND A.result='Winner' AND A.award='Television' AND A.award_category='Silver Gavel Award' AND A.organization='American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.organization = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND T1.year = 1999 AND T1.result = 'Nominee' AND T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T2.episode = 20

SELECT A.episode_id, A.role FROM Award A JOIN Person P ON A.person_id = P.person_id WHERE P.name = 'Julia Roberts' AND A.year = 1999 AND A.award = 'Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series' AND A.organization = 'Primetime Emmy Awards'
